description: Evénements routiers en Wallonie is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. This feed contains real-time traffic information and safety related traffic information for the Walloon Region: traffic events, incidents, traffic jams, disruptive works,. Coverage: SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. The portal shows the English title as "Road events in Wallonia" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2025-07-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
